translation.name: Wakʉ Itekare: Emenna' Pe Ekonekan Nɨto'

content: Pena Papa uya utamokori kon amʉ' auro'kapɨ'pɨtʉ'pʉ pu'kena' amʉ' poro tʉron nɨ a'tai'ne, tu'kan winɨ rɨ,
e'tane si serɨ ton iu'matʉ weyu ton a'tai'ne uyauro'kasa' iya 'nokon Tʉmu winɨ, tʉnanʉmʉ'pʉ tanporon nɨ anʉnnin pe iye'to' pe, iporo tanporon nɨ mɨ yawɨron kaa'pʉ iya na'ne'.

Imu esi te'wei'tɨsen Papa a'kwarii ke, mɨrɨpan esi kʉrɨ rɨ e'to' e' pe kuru rɨ, meruntɨ imaimu erupa' rɨ tanporon nɨ uko'mamʉ miyarɨ. Makoi ekorʉkato' tʉrʉ tʉpo, iyereuta'pʉ Eke emiyatʉ enwo'netʉ winɨ Epʉn po.
Mɨrɨpan si ena'pʉ eke pe inserʉ amʉ' entai, tese' tʉnanʉmʉ'pʉ esi eke pe to' ese' entai kasa.
Apʉne pʉra, nai kʉrɨ warai inserʉ pɨ' ken Papa,

content.text: “Umu ɨmɨrɨ tikin nan kuru rɨ; serɨ pe ɨkʉipʉnʉ pe enasa',”
“Ikʉipʉnʉ pe e'to' oton,
mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ umu pe iye'to' oton,”

content: Mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ kanan, tɨmʉrewato' ennoko Papa uya a'tai non pona,

content.text: “Tɨwɨ tanporo Papa inserʉʉi ton napurɨpɨtʉi,”
“Uinserʉʉi ton kupʉ uya a'setun pe,
upoitorʉ ton apo' e'werouwerouma pe,”
“Papa, ayapon e'to' oton inke rɨ, inke rɨ,
mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ ipokena' pe e'nɨto' itesa' pe ɨwesi yʉʉi pe.
Ipoken e'nɨto' i'nʉnkasa' auya, ipoken pʉra e'nɨto' ewaruma'tɨsa' auya;
mɨrɨ pe iyesi pɨ', Papa, itese' pɨ' ɨwe'to' uya ɨku'sa' ɨtonpa ton epoi,
ɨmɨrɨ tʉkarapaimai' pori' pe ɨwesi ekamanin pe,”
“Itepuru, iyepiya'tɨ yau non apon nonka'pʉ auya,
mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ ka' esi ɨyemiyatʉ ton tʉrawasooi rʉ'pʉ ton pe.
Tʉuma'ta ton nɨ, ɨmɨrɨ moro rɨ;
tanporo pon a'mota kasa ta'mota ton.
Pon pʉro'pon e'mepɨtʉ kasa e'mepɨ'to' auya oton;
pon usensima kasa isensimato' oton.
E'tane ɨmɨrɨ moro mɨrɨ kasa rɨ,
ɨukɨɨi'pamʉ pen nɨ,”

content: Nai kʉrɨ warai inserʉ pɨ' ken,

content.text: “Ereutakɨ, uyemiyatʉ enwo'netʉ winɨ
ɨyeyaton non tʉrʉ uya pʉ'kʉ pona
a'ta apon pe,”

content: Inserʉ amʉ' pen pe' kamoro a'kwarʉ ton e'tʉrawasomai' enno'sa' kon kamo epika'tɨn nɨto' eponin nan apiyo' pe?
